title: Extension Length for Returning Calloway Buyers — Homesite Reservation
content:
The extension length of a Homesite Reservation hold extension is set by the financing type of the buyer's earlier Home Purchase Agreement with Calloway that stands closed.

| Buyer's earlier Calloway Home Purchase Agreement | Extension length |
|---|---|
| stands closed with financing type Calloway Home Mortgage | 10 days |
| stands closed with financing type outside lender or cash | 8 days |
| no closed Calloway Home Purchase Agreement | the class's extension days |

## Reading the record

The Home Purchase Agreement record shows its status and its financing type. Only an agreement with status closed is read; an agreement that is ratified, under construction, closing scheduled, cancelled or terminated does not count as a closed agreement.

## Cases (hypothetical buyers)

- Closed agreement financed through Calloway Home Mortgage: 10 days.
- Closed agreement bought for cash: 8 days.
- Closed agreement financed by an outside lender: 8 days.
- First-time Calloway buyer with no Home Purchase Agreement: the class's extension days.
